shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,180p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; printf '\\n--- package ---\\n'; cat package.json; printf '\\n--- app ---\\n'; sed -n '1,220p' src/App.tsx; printf '\\n--- main ---\\n'; cat src/main.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "npm install @gravity-ui/date-components @gravity-ui/date-utils && node -e \"for (const p of ['@gravity-ui/date-components','@gravity-ui/date-utils']) console.log(p, require(p+'/package.json').version)\" && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/docs node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/build/docs 2>/dev/null || true"

/bin/bash -lc "npm view @gravity-ui/date-components versions --json | tail -80 && printf '\\n--- peer versions ---\\n' && for v in 4.5.0 4.4.0 4.3.0 4.2.0 4.1.0 4.0.0 3.9.0 3.8.0; do echo -n \""'$v "; npm view "@gravity-ui/date-components@$v" peerDependencies --json; done'

/bin/bash -lc "npm install @gravity-ui/date-components@4.1.0 @gravity-ui/date-utils && node -e \"for (const p of ['@gravity-ui/date-components','@gravity-ui/date-utils']) console.log(p, require(p+'/package.json').version)\" && find node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components -maxdepth 3 -iname 'INDEX.md' -o -maxdepth 3 -iname 'README.md' | head -20"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/docs/INDEX.md; printf '\\n--- calendar refs ---\\n'; rg -l -i 'calendar' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/docs | head -20; printf '\\n--- setup ---\\n'; rg -n -i -C 3 'required setup|styles|ThemeProvider|locale' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/README.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/docs/guides -g '*.md' | head -160"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/docs/components/Calendar.md; printf '\\n--- types ---\\n'; rg -n 'declare (const|function) Calendar|type CalendarProps|interface CalendarProps|value:|onChange:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist -g 'Calendar*.d.ts' | head -120"
/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && git diff -- package.json src/App.tsx src/main.tsx | sed -n '1,220p'"
